body: I map the data architecture before I open Figma. Systems that scale are designed from the state outward — the interface is a consequence of good architecture, not the other way around.
label: Engineering Philosophy

body: Every unnecessary kilobyte, every blocking request, every layout shift is a decision made against the person using what I built. Speed is not a feature to add later. It is the baseline.
label: User Philosophy

body: Every color, every radius, every spacing value is a decision. I refuse templates because they carry someone else's decisions. This portfolio was built token by token, argument by argument.
label: Design Philosophy
